name: Machine Seated Torso Rotation
steps: Adjust the swivel seat to one side, sit upright with your lower body locked into the seat pads, and brace your upper body against the chest pads.
Grip the fixed handles firmly to keep your shoulders square and facing forward.
Rotate your hips and lower torso smoothly against the resistance by contracting your obliques through a controlled arc.
Return slowly to the starting angle without letting the stack clang, then adjust the machine to repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Initiate every twist from your obliques rather than pulling with your arms or shoulders.
Keep your spine tall and stay within a smooth, comfortable range of trunk rotation.
